Helping an investment business launch products faster

Identifying the operating and technology changes needed to support growth.

The objective

Reduce the time and cost required to launch new managed investment products.

Mak’s contribution

Mak led an assessment of the business and technology architecture supporting the brokerage operation. He developed the business case and a four-year transformation roadmap covering 45 projects.

The outcome

The CV reports launch time falling from 18 months to eight months, and launch cost from $14 million to $6 million. The timing and attribution of those improvements need confirmation.

Source: Makarand Datar’s account.

The experience this brings

Connecting growth ambitions with a practical programme of operating and technology changes.
